thread:
Aaron: Quick sync on last night's canary that hit the quota limiter. We saw retries and downstream errors at ~10% traffic. Need owners for auto-rollback, constrained flag scopes, blast-radius caps, telemetry, and gating tests. Who volunteers?
Maya: I can own auto-rollback. Plan: simple canary failure detector + controller that watches error rate and traffic %. Prototype PR by EOD Thu, include runbook snippet.
Leo: I'll take blast-radius controls and canary sampling. Proposal: default cap to 2 regions and max 5% traffic for new flags, plus an enforceable safety quota in front of flags. Design doc Wed, staged config change Fri.
Priya: Ill do flag scoping and telemetry. Immediate: remove the 50% ramp step and restrict audience. Add per-flag error-rate metric + alert (pager if >1% over 5m). Dashboard + alert by Monday.
Zach: I'll add gating e2e tests to simulate quota exhaustion and ensure rollback path works. Test harness + CI job by next week.
oncall-bot: Incident #1291 (staged deploy quota limiter) https://incidents.redwood/1291; postmortem draft: https://docs.redwood/postmortems/1291
Maya: Tech note: rollback detector pseudo: ```if canary_error_rate > threshold and canary_traffic_pct > min_pct: trigger_rollback(flag_id)``` threshold and min_pct should be per-flag config.
Leo: Suggest adding soft-fallback routing (route to smaller model variant) in rollout policies to avoid cascade. Can reuse routing policy code.
Aaron: Assigning owners in tracker: Maya = auto-rollback (PR Thu), Leo = blast-radius & sampling (design Wed, config Fri), Priya = flag scope + telemetry (dashboard Mon), Zach = gating tests (CI next week). Everyone add checklist item in the postmortem and drop PR links here.
Priya: Added checklist and dashboard wireframe in the postmortem. Pinged infra for alerting thresholds.
Maya: Scheduling a 30m handoff tomorrow 10am PT to walk through the rollback controller API. Invite sent.
Zach: Will add e2e test matrix to the checklist.
Aaron: Thanks all. Marking this high priority. Next check: Tue 9am to confirm rollouts. :calendar:
